sentences.en: In this method the bacteria are distributed in a gelatine or agar medium liquefied by heat, and the medium is then poured out on sterile glass plates or in shallow glass dishes, and allowed to solidify.
sentences.vi: Trong phương pháp này, vi khuẩn được phân bố trong môi trường gelatine hoặc thạch được hóa lỏng bằng nhiệt, và môi trường này sau đó được đổ ra đĩa thủy tinh vô trùng hoặc trong đĩa thủy tinh nông, và để đông đặc.

sentences.en: The watercooled ring channel K protects the bottom outlet of the generator and causes the cinders to solidify, so that they can be easily removed.

sentences.en: Once you solidify your basic skincare and beauty knowledge, consider moving on to the Beyond the Basics kit.

sentences.en: The film's tagline, "more fearful than the monster himself," is a great representation of how classics used a single line of copy to solidify a classic horror movie poster.

sentences.en: The mass of glass is rolled on a polished slab of iron, the " marvor," to solidify it, and it is then slightly hollowed by blowing.
